info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Order Management API
info.description: The Order Management API facilitates the creation of servicing orders within the banking system. This endpoint allows clients to submit new servicing requests that are essential for handling customer inquiries and actions related to their accounts. Whether it's updating account information or processing specific banking services, this API serves financial institutions and their support teams. Typical use cases include initiating requests for account modifications or transaction adjustments, ensuring a seamless experience for banking customers.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new servicing order by providing the necessary order details. It ensures that all required information is supplied to process the order efficiently.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new servicing order. It must include all required information pertaining to the servicing order such as customer details, service type, and specific requests.
